name: Sawari Rent
summary: A car rental desk: fleet, drag-to-move booking timeline, fuel and mileage handover, maintenance
about: A rent-a-car counter for a Pakistani city, priced in PKR. It shows which car is free, books it with or without a driver and with out-of-city charges, records fuel and odometer when the keys go out and come back, bills extra kilometres and missing fuel, and keeps a maintenance due list. Good for a rent-a-car office, a tour operator or a company car pool.
how: The road line drives in under the tabs; the Overview shows the whole fleet as coloured slots and live trip progress.
On Bookings, drag an amber bar along its row to move the dates, or onto another car's row. Clashes bounce back with a warning.
Press New booking, pick a car and dates, tick With driver or choose an out-of-city destination: the price breaks down as you type.
Open Handover and pick a car: the fuel needle sweeps and the odometer rolls. Enter the return reading and fuel to see extra km, fuel and late charges.
Maintenance lists service by kilometres, token tax and insurance; press Mark serviced to reset the next service.
Reports show income per car, the driver mix, out-of-city trips and a four-week utilisation heatmap.
